edit.helpText: Leave a field blank t' keep th' original. Changes be stored fer this hoard only, unless ye enable “Override globally”.
edit.noArtworkAlbum: No covers spied — th' treasure needs a MusicBrainz match.
edit.noArtworkArtist: No online artwork spied — needs a fanart.tv API key an' a MusicBrainz match.

overrideGlobally.help: Also show this edit across yer whole catalog (yer highest-priority hoard wins). Doesn't change th' original or affect other crew.

reset.confirmMessage: Reset t' original metadata? This clears yer edits fer this item.

genres.counts: {albumsFormatted} {albums, plural, one {treasure} other {treasures}} · {artistsFormatted} {artists, plural, one {artist} other {artists}}
genres.empty: No genres yet — they arrive wi' treasure metadata as yer hoard be enriched.

label.albumCountWithPrefix: Label · {count, plural, one {# treasure} other {# treasures}}

labels.empty: No labels yet — they fill in as yer catalog be enriched from MusicBrainz.

lyrics.plainHelp: Plain lyrics — one line each, no timin'.
lyrics.resetToAutoTitle: Forget this edit an' re-fetch from th' provider
lyrics.syncedHelp: One line per lyric, each prefixed wi' a timestamp like [00:12.34]; untimed lines be dropped.

report.helpText: Edit {name}'s details below. Stow changes t' a hoard ye own instantly, or submit 'em as a suggestion fer all hands (an admin reviews those). Only changed fields be sent.
report.libraryTarget: Choose which hoard t' stow t'
report.noteHint: Only sent wi' a suggestion. Anythin' that helps reviewers (e.g. a source link).
